title: About Sunflower Land

# About Sunflower Land

Sunflower Land is a **community-driven Web3 farming game** where every action matters. Plant crops, raise animals, complete quests, and trade with thousands of other players across the world.

With over **600,000+ farms created**, a thriving NFT marketplace, and non-stop seasonal updates, Sunflower Land is not just a game — it’s a living, breathing world shaped by its players.

![](</about sunflowerland/animation.gif>)

_The information provided on this website does not constitute investment advice, financial advice, trading advice, or any other sort of advice and you should not treat any of the website’s content as such. We do not recommend that any cryptocurrency should be bought, sold, or held by you. Use the information from these pages at your own risk._

# **🔑Crypto & Digital Collectibles**

Sunflower Land is powered by Web3. That means your **tokens, SFTs (stackable collectibles), and NFTs (unique items)** can live on-chain and be freely owned/traded by you.

Sunflower Land Digital Collectibles are traded **in-game** and also supported on all major secondary NFT marketplaces.

👉 **Important:** You only need to set up a wallet once you’re ready to trade, deposit, or withdraw assets. Most of the game can be played without touching Web3 at first.

### **FLOWER ERC20**

FLOWER is the native ERC20 token used for trading & premium actions in game. (see $FLOWER ERC20)

[Uniswap - Buy now](https://app.uniswap.org/swap?chain=base&inputCurrency=0x3e12b9d6a4d12cd9b4a6d613872d0eb32f68b380&outputCurrency=0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913&value=1&field=input) 

![](</about sunflowerland/flowererc.png>)

###   
**Farm Collectibles**

Supply limited cosmetics & items to boost your farm.

[https://opensea.io/collection/sunflower-land-collectibles](https://opensea.io/collection/sunflower-land-collectibles)

![](</about sunflowerland/collectibles.png>)

### **Bumpkin Wearables**

Fashionable cosmetic & powerful outfits for your Bumpkin.  
[https://opensea.io/collection/bumpkin-wearables](https://opensea.io/collection/bumpkin-wearables)

![](</about sunflowerland/wearables.png>)

### **Bud NFTs**

Sprouted from the ground, these unique collectibles can give buffs for your farm.

[https://opensea.io/collection/sunflower-land-buds](https://opensea.io/collection/sunflower-land-buds)

![](</about sunflowerland/buds.png>)

title: How to start
markdown:
# How to start

## **🚀 Step 1: Create Your Account**

Head over to [**sunflower-land.com/play**](https://sunflower-land.com/play) and click **Create Account**.

You’ll be given two ways to start:

###### **Google Login (Recommended)**

The easiest way for new players.

Just sign in with Google and your farming adventure will begin

###### **Web3 Wallet (Advanced)**

Use MetaMask, Sequence, or other wallets if you want to login with

Recommended for experienced players who already use crypto.

## **🌱 Step 2: Start Playing**

Once your account is created, you can jump right into farming! Follow the in-game tutorial and let **Pumpkin Pete** guide you through your first crops.

## **💬 Need Help?**

Check the in-game tutorial.

Visit our [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/sunflowerland) to chat with other farmers and goblins.

## **❓ Transferring an account?**

Sunflower Land accounts are NFTs that can be traded. It is **not recommended** to purchase and use someone else's farm - the account may be banned and/or items removed.

title: FAQ
markdown:
# FAQ ## How much money will I earn/how many flowers will I make per week/how to profit/etc? The short answer: **Nothing**. This game is not a source of easy income or a money making scheme. What it is, is a game that allows you to keep the value of investments that you make into it. With most games, you can spend money on items or powerups, but after you get some utility out of it in the game, your money is essentially gone. In Sunflower Land, you retain your investments, and can sell off resources or items later and reclaim their value. You can read more about the developer's vision here: [Healthy Gaming](https://docs.sunflower-land.com/project/healthy-gaming) The long answer is that after investing a **large** amount of time, effort, and _real money_ (existing capital) into the game; building up your farm, leveling your character, and buying expensive resource-boosting items, it is possible to get your income to self-sustaining levels, allowing you to pay for your VIP subscription, sfl.world notification bot, and regular expenses for resources, entirely from the FLOWER you earn from deliveries and trading resources. Progressing further may allow you to set aside some FLOWER from your earnings to trade for fiat currency, but it is strongly recommended that you just use the money you earn to re-invest back into the game and grow your farm even further. ## When Do Deliveries Reset? NPC deliveries reset time is at 00:00 UTC. (Note: You get a new delivery if the previous one is completed.) ## Help! I ran out of coins and can't buy more seeds. Don't worry, this is not as bad as it seems. Sunflower seeds cost 0.01 coins, and can be sold for 0.02. Slow going, but you can get back on your feet this way. If you literally have zero coins and cannot sell any resources or treasures of any kind, don't panic. Visit the Plaza and find any player, then travel to their farm (magnifying glass icon). Follow the prompts to clean their farm, then take the weeds and dung you collected to Garbo at the Goblin Retreat to make a few Coins. You can do this five times per day by default. While you're waiting, collect the mushrooms that appear on your farm periodically, and make them into Mushroom Stew at the Firepit. Wait until one of the Goblins requests some, then use the FLOWER to buy crops and sell them for coins. If you can't access the Retreat, or buy resources on the Marketplace just yet, simply wait a few days until your daily reward comes up Coins or the Mega Reward, and you will be back to farming before you know it. ## What is a bee swarm? Once your Bee Hive is at 100%, when you collect honey from it, there is a 10% chance of summoning a Bee Swarm which gives all of your crops a +0.2 boost. There are skills to increase the chance of a swarm and the amount of the boost. This is on top of any fertilizers and multiple swarm bonuses will stack. Read more about [flower gardening](/en/mechanics/flowers). ## What is Full Moon? Full moon is a special day that occurs once in 4 weeks wherein there are increased chances of catching Marine Marvels. The Full Moon Day also comes with 3 special moon fruit seeds (you can only buy 1 of each at Betty) and if you plant them, you can use those fruits in the lava pit (volcano island), sell them on the marketplace or sell to Betty for coins. In addition, if the season is Summer and you have Eggplant growing, they will all instantly mature at reset time. ## What are moon berries? Moon berries are 3 special moon fruit seeds (you can only buy 1 of each at Betty on a Full Moon Day) and if you plant them, you can use those fruits in the lava pit (volcano island), sell them on the marketplace or sell to Betty for coins. They can also be used for the Lunar Doll crafting item. Although you can only buy the seeds during a Full Moon Day, you can plant and harvest them at any time. Read more about the [Full Moon](/en/mechanics/seasons#full-moon). ## What is Sunstone? Sunstone is a precious non-tradeable resource. You can mine each sunstone node 10 times (needs a golden pickaxe). It takes 3 days for the sunstone to reset so that you can mine it again. Each mine gives you 1 Sunstone. Once you are done mining 10 sunstones, the node will disappear. The sunstones you mined, can be exchanged at Infernos Island (unlocked at level 30) for additional resource nodes that you can place on your farm. (Like tree/fruit plot/stone/iron etc.)  Read more about [Sunstone](/en/mechanics/sunstone). ## I am on Petal Paradise and I have no double delivery? / No Fish frenzy etc.? You are in a separate calendar for the initial 2-week period when you upgrade, where you have different events than the rest of the players. After the 2-week period, you join the main calendar and your seasons sync with the rest of the players. Please see your in-game calendar to assess the events. ## Where to by pumpkin seed? Pumpkin is an autumn-only seed. If you are on 2nd island, you can plant it in the Autumn season. On basic island it is perpetually Spring, so you will only be able to purchase pumpkin off of the marketplace. ## How to do delivery? You need to go to where the respective NPCs are located and deliver the items. If you click on an NPC delivery, it will show you where they are located. Example: Raven is located at Pumpkin Plaza, so you need to head there and look for her. Read more about [deliveries](/en/mechanics/deliveries). ## What is the chest at the Beach? There is a chest that you can unlock at Beach daily. To get to it, you need to unlock Pirate Potion and equip your Bumpkin with the potion. How to get Pirate Potion? By giving flowers / doing deliveries for Old Salty. Please see this >>> [_https://sfl.world/info/flowers_](https://sfl.world/info/flowers) The pirate chest is in the north near the dig site, the chest in the south near Corale requires a Rare Key to open. ## How to decide what food to cook? If I am looking to level up quick, I will sacrifice cost and go for high XP food and cook that. If I am slowing the leveling, I will prefer cost-efficient food. Every food is useful in some way, though. Read more about [cooking](/en/mechanics/cooking). ## What to do with my second hen house? If you have more than 1 Hen House, you can sell your second Hen House to [Garbo](/en/npcs/garbo). Game mechanics have changed. Now chickens are housed inside the Hen House and the building can be levelled up to house more chickens. ## What is the use of Farm Hands? / Should I craft Beds? Beds help employ farm hands. You can appoint 1 farm hand for every 1 unique bed on your farm. (Meaning you cannot just build a second Basic Bed) If you have more than 1 wearable with boosts, you can equip other farm hands with your additional wearables so that those boosts apply to your farm.  (Example: if you have carrot amulet + beetroot amulet, then by equipping one farm hand with carrot amulet and the other farm hand with beetroot amulet, both boosts can apply to the farm.) Read more about Farmhands[farmhands](/en/mechanics/farmhands). ## How to join factions? There are 4 factions to choose from. To join a faction, you need to be a level 7 or above. You meet that criterion; the Kingdom becomes accessible. Once you decide on which faction you'd like to join, you can walk up to the NPC in front of their HQ in the Kingdom, pay the joining fee and join the faction. Read more about [Factions](/en/factions). The joining fee is based on the faction leaderboard placements from the previous week.  1st Place: 50 Flower  2nd Place: 30 Flower  3rd Place: 10 Flower  4th Place: 5 Flower ## Can I leave the faction? How to leave the faction? Yes, it is possible to leave a faction. You need to sell all of your emblems (if any). You will also need to use up your marks that you earned in that faction or you will lose them once you leave. After you have sold off the emblems and used up your marks, head to the NPC inside your faction where you can see emblems, and scroll to the very end till you see a leave faction button. (Ref. image.) Click on it and leave the faction. Please note: To join another faction, you will once again need to pay the joining fee. Even if you join another one right away, you will be unable to get an XP bonus from the faction pet for six weeks. ## I cannot buy a music box, will my chickens die? Animals are so expensive what to do? It's not mandatory to use the music box, you can feed the chicken when it wakes up, only difference being it requires a little more food to compensate for the music box xp. Animals are not recommended for new players as they are difficult to sustain. What you can do is bring the chickens to the required bounty level and sell them off. ## When does the Gift Giver appear? Gift givers are real players, admins / devs who appear anywhere in the game at any given time of their choosing and the players who spot them and interact, get a present, so... they have no set time. ## Where to buy land? We do not recommend purchasing a land from someone because it could be banned or might get banned because of what the previous owner of that land might have done prior to selling. **Your account will also be restricted for 90 days after the date of trade, during which time you cannot withdraw resources, or sell items on the marketplace (including accepting offers).** ## Where are fruit plots? I just upgraded to Petal Paradise. If you have recently acquired fruit plots, they will have apple trees planted automatically. You need to harvest the trees fully (3 - 5 harvests) post which the tree will die. You need an axe to dig out that dead tree stump after which you can plant a new fruit. (Get seeds from Betty in your farm, where you get all other crop seeds.) Read more about [fruit farming](/en/mechanics/harvesting#fruit). ## How to participate in Goblin Raffle? The Goblin Raffle has been merged into the Chapter Raffle system. Visit the Prizes box in the Auctioneer's house and look for the raffle that uses the Prize Ticket. ## Do SFTs stack? Can you get more than one of the same item and combine their bonuses? No, every SFT will provide one boost no matter how many of them you own. Different items that provide the same bonus will stack, though (Desert Rose and Chicory both provide +10% additional flower chance). In addition, some items are incompatible with one another and will cancel out a lower bonus: 1. Angel Wings and Devil Wings are different items but have the same bonus so only one will work at a time 2. Karkinos is disabled if Cabbage Boy is present 3. Nancy is disabled if Scarecrow or Kuebiko are present 4. Scarecrow is disabled if Kuebiko is present 5. Woody the Beaver is disabled if Apprentice Beaver or Foreman Beaver are present 6. Apprentice Beaver is disabled if Foreman Beaver is present 7. Faction helmet is burned to obtain the Faction Crown; if bought again, the helmet is only cosmetic ## Why verification? This protocol is in place to prevent abuse of system via multi-accounting and botting. Also, it does not store your image, just a graphical representation. Read more about [verification](/en/mechanics/verification). ## Gnome Order? "BRO" (Blue, Red, Orange) ## What is Plot Fertility? A Plot fertility = Ability to use crop plots. This is connected to the water well. If you don't upgrade the water well and get too many plots, you'll see some are dry and can’t be used. Read more about [wells](/en/mechanics/harvesting#plot-fertility-water-well). ## How to access Town Hall during streams? Town Hall - [_https://sunflower-land.com/play/#/world/stream_](https://sunflower-land.com/play/#/world/stream) ## What is a mutant chicken? When you collect from your chickens in the Hen House, they have a chance of dropping a mutant chicken. The higher the level of the chicken, the more are the chances of one dropping a mutant. ## How to exchange Love Charms for $Flower? Head to Plaza. Click on the balloon. The time shown there is your LOCAL time and not UTC. Take the balloon during that time and head to Love Island. Exchange tokens at the well. ![](/faq/3.png) ## What do Guardians do? The guardians double positive events and protect the farm against disasters. Example: If it's Bountiful Harvest and you get +1 crop, with the Summer guardian, it will become +2. This applies to the Fish Frenzy (+2 Fish), Sunshower (75% faster crop plot speed), and Full Moon (+200% chance for Marine Marvel map pieces) events also. The only thing it does not affect is Double Delivery Day. ## What does the Chef Apron do? If a goblin is asking for a cake and paying you 1 $Flower for it and you have a Bumpkin / Farm Hand equipped with the Chef Apron, then the goblin will pay you 1x120% = 1.2 $Flower for it. ## I tried to withdraw $Flower and now that transaction is stuck and I cannot claim sales from marketplace. You need to push that stuck transaction by submitting it on chain. (Please ensure you have ETH on base to cover gas fees.) Once that transaction goes through, the marketplace claim issue will resolve. ## How much oil do we need per crop in greenhouse? ![](/faq/4.png) * Grapes- 3 Oil (2 with Slick Saver Skill) * Rice- 4 Oil (3 with Slick Saver) * Olives- 6 Oil (5 with Slick Saver) The skill Greasy Plants will double the amount of Oil required to grow a plant, in exchange for +1 to its yield. ## Tools Restock? ![](/faq/5.png) | Particulars | Axes

# Beginner's Guide

**|** [**Beginner's Guide Draft**](/en/beginners/guide-draft) **|** [**Liquidity Pool Rewards**](/en/beginners/liquidity-pool) **|** [**Stock & Limits**](/en/beginners/stock-limits) **|** [**Travel Map**](/en/beginners/map) **|**

## Beginner's Guide

Sunflower Land is designed as a journey — from a humble farmer planting seeds to a master explorer unlocking rare resources, crafting advanced items, and shaping the economy.

This guide gives a **high-level overview** of what players can do at each stage.

## **🌻 Early Stages**

Start small, learn the basics, and grow your farm.

##### **Crops & Fruit – Buy seeds at the market, plant & harvest for coins**

![](/beginners_guide/crops_and_fruits.png)

##### **Tools & Gathering – Craft one-time-use tools to gather resources.**

![](/beginners_guide/tools_and_gathering.png)

##### **Cooking & Levelling – Cook meals, feed your Bumpkin, and level up.**

![](/beginners_guide/cooking_and_leveling.png)

##### **Seasons - Every 7 days a new season with new crops, fish + weather events**

![](/beginners_guide/seasons.png)

##### Expanding – Grow your island and unlock new regions with more resources.

## **🐮 Mid-Game**

Once established, your farm expands into new systems and challenges.

##### **Fishing – Compost to create bait, chum the waters, and catch fish.**

![](/beginners_guide/fishing.png)

##### **Animals – Feed animals to produce eggs, milk, wool, and other materials.**

![](/beginners_guide/animals.png)

##### **Crafting – Build items needed for farming, trading, and quests.**

![](/beginners_guide/crafting.png)

##### **Flowers & Honey – Cross-breed flowers and harvest honey**

![](/beginners_guide/flowers_and_honey.png)

## **🔥 Late Game**

High-level systems for experienced farmers.

*   **Oil** – Extract oil on the Desert Island to fuel Crop Machines, Greenhouses, and speed up cooking.
*   **Obsidian** – Gather resources at Lava Pits to craft Obsidian, a high-end material for boosts.
*   **Pets** – Collect and feed pets; earn unique pet resources used in powerful shrines.
*   **Digging** – Explore the beach, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden treasures.
*   **Potion House** – Assist the Potion Master by crafting magical potions for rare prizes.

![](/beginners_guide/volcano.png)

⚡ **Tip:** The game evolves every Chapter (every 3 months) with new mechanics, SFTs, and NFTs — so farming is always growing with you.

#####   
**⚔️ Factions**

As you progress, you’ll have the chance to **join a Faction** and align yourself with one of Sunflower Land’s communities:

*   🌻 **Sunflorians**
*   🧑‍🌾 **Bumpkins**
*   🌑 **Nightshades**
*   👺 **Goblins**

Once you’ve joined, you can take part in **weekly competitions**. These events pit players against each other in farming, crafting, or resource challenges.

*   **Top performers within each faction** earn bonus rewards

## To-Do

*   “what should i look at next” (create a small list of pages that beginners should look at after getting a grasp on basic mechanics)

# Beginner's Guide (90.69%) Sunflower Land is designed as a journey. From a humble farmer planting seeds to a master explorer unlocking rare resources, crafting advanced items, and shaping the economy. This guide serves as your compass in exploring the vast world of Sunflower Land.  **For returning players** please read the [recap section](/en/beginners/guide-draft#lxix-returning-players) first. ![](/user-pages/jaepi/guide-uwu/gamerules.png) # I. EARLY GAME Your journey begins after [creating a Farm](/en/home/start). Learn and explore the basics on the Basic/Tutorial Island. The upper-left menu (Bumpkin portrait) now has icons for the Calendar and the Chapter Dashboard. ![](/user-pages/jaepi/guide-uwu/lv1-new-farm.png) A newly created farm. ## 1\. Tools & Gathering Wood & Minerals Gathering resources is your first task. Start chopping down Trees for Wood using the Axe tool provided to you. As you advance, you'll be able to mine Minerals (Gold, Iron, and Stone). The right tool is needed to harvest each kind of resource node. Tools are consumables (ex. you lose 1 Axe each time you chop down 1 Tree) thus you're going to craft more Tools at Blacksmith's Workbench for future gathering. | ![](/user-pages/jaepi/guide-uwu/home-blacksmith'sworkbench.png)
Blacksmith's Workbench | | --- | ## 2\. Land Expansion You can expand your land to increase space and discover more Resource nodes once you've acquired the expansion materials required. Completing an expansion will instantly regenerate most Resource Nodes (Trees, Stone, Iron, Gold, Crimstone and Oil Wells only). You can use Gems to instantly complete the Expansion time (Basic/Tutorial and Petal Island only). | ![](/user-pages/jaepi/guide-uwu/home-expansion.png)
Expansion button. | ![](/user-pages/jaepi/guide-uwu/home-completeexpansion.png)
Completed expansion. | | --- | --- | Resources needed for [future expansions.](https://sfl.world/info/expansion) ## 3\. Seeds & Growing Crops After finishing your initial Land Expansion you'll be able to plant and harvest crops by unlocking the Crop Plots. You can buy more seeds and sell your harvested crops for Coins at Betty's Market. It will always be Spring Season on the  Basic/Tutorial Island which only allows you plant crops/produce limited for Spring Season. You'll unlock the full four-seasons once you upgrade to Petal Island.  | ![](/user-pages/jaepi/guide-uwu/home-betty's_market.png)
Betty's Market. | | --- | ## 4\. Cooking & Leveling After finishing your second Land Expansion, you discover the Fire Pit ([a type of Cooking Building](/en/mechanics/cooking)). You can now cook and prepare food to feed and level up your Bumpkin. For additional food options, construct the other Cooking Buildings from the Blacksmith's Workbench Build Tab. | ![](/user-pages/jaepi/guide-uwu/home-firepit.png)
Fire Pit. | ![](/user-pages/jaepi/guide-uwu/home-feedbumpkin.png)
Feed via Main Bumpkin. | | --- | --- | ## 5\. Deliveries & World Map Delivery is a system where NPCs request specific items (Crops, Resources, Food, Flowers and Crafted items) in exchange for rewards like Coins, $FLOWER, and Chapter Tickets. You can ignore Chapter Ticket deliveries at this stage. To complete a delivery, travel through the World Map to various locations (Plaza, Beach, Kingdom and Retreat) and interact with the corresponding NPC. The first 15 deliveries refresh automatically while deliveries from the 16th onward reset once daily at 00:00 UTC. Each day, a new delivery is assigned for each NPC. However keep in mind that not all deliveries are profitable nor worth completing. You can skip a delivery if it was assigned to you on the previous day. ![](/user-pages/jaepi/guide-uwu/map-world.png) World Map with NPC locations and relevant buildings. On the Retreat Map, the Goblin Raffle is also defunct. More info regarding [NPC Delivery.](/en/mechanics/deliveries) ## 6\. Water Well & Plot Fertility Some Crop Plots appear dried up when you discover them which makes them unusable for planting. Building a Water Well gives them their plot fertility that enables you to plant crops on them. You need to upgrade your Water Well as you unlock more Crop Plots. ## 7\. Currency / Coupons There are plenty of in-game currency which might confuse you at first. Below is a list that coves most of the currencies you would encounter. The primary currencies: * **$FLOWER** - main Token of Sunflower Land; Used for purchasing at the Market Place; $FLOWER Auctions. * **Gems** - used for Gem Restocks, VIP purchase, Land Expansions Cost, Gem Auctions. * **Coins** - used to buy Seeds & Tools; Land Expansion and Building Cost, Potion Room. Some supplementary currencies: * **Love Charms** - can be exchanged to $FLOWER (50 LC=1 $FLOWER); Used to buy at the Love Shop. * **Marks** - used for purchasing at Eldric (Faction Shop). * **Emblems** \- used to boost the Marks earned in Faction Tasks. * **Chapter Tickets** - currently Bracelets (Chapter 11); Used for Ticket Auctions and purchasing at Stella's Shop. * **Potion Tickets** \- used for purchasing at Eins' Potion Shop. More info regarding [in-game currency.](/en/home/tokens) ## 8\. Restocking The Daily Shipment provides only a small number of basic/medium seeds and tools. Skills do not affect the Daily Shipment. Restocking the Market, Workbench or Treasure Shop requires Gems as payment. Using Gems for restocks is an intended part of the game’s progression. ![Tool Restock breakdown](/user-pages/jaepi/guide-uwu/faq_tool_restock.png) Tool Restock breakdown. ![Seed Restock breakdown](/user-pages/jaepi/guide-uwu/faq_seed_restock.png) Seed Restock breakdown. More info regarding [stocks & limits.](/en/beginners/stock-limits) ## 9\. Skills & Specialization Skills gives you the ability to enhance your farming experience by providing a multitude of boosts and quality of life functions. You gain one Skill point per Bumpkin level increase. Allocate your skill points carefully and strategically especially at this stage. You can redistribute your skill points via the skill reset. Each player receives a free skill reset then the next one becomes available after 180-days. If you want to reset your skills before the 180-day cooldown period, you'll have to spend some Gems. Gem cost increases incrementally after each Gem reset. More info regarding [Skills and Specialization.](/en/mechanics/skills) ## 10\. Limited Market Place Access You can purchase crops, resources, power-ups, and cosmetic items at the Marketplace. However, selling items (for $FLOWER) is still locked at this stage. More info regarding the [Marketplace](/en/mechanics/marketplace). ## 11\. Reputation  Increase your Reputation to unlock more game features (Market-Place Listings and Offers, $FLOWERS Deliveries and more). More info regarding [Reputation.](/en/mechanics/reputation) ## 12\. Minting of Farm / Store on Chain Minting your Farm turns your land into an NFT and registers it on the blockchain, granting you access to blockchain transactions. To mint your farm, you must have POL for the gas fee and reach Seedling [Reputation](/en/mechanics/reputation) (250 reputation points). Go to the Retreat and head north-east and look for the the Goblin with the Wallet Icon.  After your farm is minted, you can now withdraw and deposit wearables, collectibles, and in-game items. A minted farm is required for $FLOWER withdrawal but is not required for $FLOWER deposit. The "Mint Your Farm" button will be replaced to the "Store On-Chain" option once minting is complete. Store on chain saves your game progress to the the blockchain and resets the Hoarding Limit. You'll be prompted to store on chain (requires POL for gas fee) when you reach a hoarding limit. ## 13\. Proof of Humanity / Verification This protocol is in place to prevent abuse of system via multi-accounting and botting. The face scans do not store your face an image/selfie but only as a graphical representation.  ![](/user-pages/jaepi/guide-uwu/infog-mint-humanity.png) ## 14\. Daily Chest The Daily Chest provides free items and will be shown to you after you log in for the first time after game reset. If you don't want to open it right away, you can close the window and find it again at the Mailbox on your Farmhouse. You can also see the upcoming rewards provided that you maintain a daily streak. More info regarding the [Daily Chest.](/en/mechanics/chests#daily-chest) ## 15\. VIP Access Getting the VIP Access has many perks which include:  * +10% EXP Boost * Cooking Building queue (Set a food to begin after the current one finishes) * Crafting Box queue * Multi-Cast fishing (Use multiple rods in one go) * Additional $FLOWER Deliveries * 600 Reputation points (Enough to remove all marketplace restrictions immediately) * VIP-only Marketplace Purchases * Chapter-exclusive bonus * VIP Reward Milestones in Chapter Track * Discount on expansion costs * Bonus daily food item ## 16\. Farm Collectibles Collectibles are supply limited cosmetics and items to boost your farm. These can be found in your inventory and be placed in your land. Duplicates of collectibles with boost don't stack. [Some Boosts don't stack](/en/faq#which-sfts-do-not-stack) More info regarding [Collectibles.](/en/sfts) ## 17\. Bumpkin Wearables Wearables are fashionable cosmetic & powerful outfits for your Bumpkin. These can be equipped on the Equip tab when you click your Bumpkin Profile or your Farmhands. Duplicates of wearables with boost don't stack. More info regarding [Wearables.](/en/sfts) ## 18\. Bud NFTs Buds have sprouted from the ground and these unique collectibles can give buffs for your farm. Buds are bought at the Marketplace and can rarely be won in a special Chapter Raffle. More info regarding [Buds](/en/mechanics/buds) ## 19\. Pets NFT & Common Hatch a friendly creature to care for on your farm! Pets eat different foods every day, which gives them the energy to bring you valuable items. These treasures can be used to build Shrines that provide week-long buffs, and as bait to catch rare Crustaceans. Or you can just sell them to other players. NFT Pets are unique creatures that can do more than common ones, but must be bought or won in an auction. Common pets are more than sufficient for most players. More info regarding [Farm Pets](/en/mechanics/pets) ## 20\. Kingdom Mini Games ![](/user-pages/jaepi/guide-uwu/npc-billy.png) Billy (Mini-games) You can access the Kingdom at Level 7. It may be too early to join a Faction at this stage but you can start playing from Billy's Mini Games to earn Marks for free. You can claim Marks once daily in  the mini-game when you complete the objective or target score. Emblems do not affect/multiply the Marks earned in the mini-games. ## 21\. Landscaping Mode and Biomes You can rearrange and decorate your farm using the Landscaping Mode. Biomes are “skin” to change your farm’s appearance but only the Prestige you reached can be purchased. More info regarding Landscaping Mode. ## 22\. Love Island/Mystery Island Fly to the Love Island via the heart Balloon (located at the Plaza) and complete the Puzzle to earn a Bronze Love Box. More info regarding [Mystery Island.](/en/events/love-island) ## 23\. Gift Giver & Town Hall ![](/user-pages/jaepi/guide-uwu/giftgiver.png) a Gift Giver. Gift Givers are the players (Devs/Admins) with the Gift/Love Charm icon above their avatars. They can show up anywhere and any at time where the players who spot and interact with them are rewarded a Gift.  Town hall is the location where players can access and claim Love Charm and Gift Rewards from the Gift Giver. It is only available during a weekly Dev Live-stream on Discord or Twitch. Town Hall Link: [https://sunflower-land.com/play/#/world/stream](https://sunflower-land.com/play/#/world/stream) ## 24\. Social Farming  You can now follow your fellow Farmers, send messages and visit their farms. Earn Love Charms as you Cheer your Friend's Farm and Help complete their Cooking Pots, Bigt Fruits and Monuments. More info regarding [Social Farming.](/en/mechanics/social) ## 25\. Community-made Resources Familiarize yourself with community-made resources such as sfl.world, Combo Maker and YouTube Content Creators to gain a better understanding of the game and improve your overall gaming experience.  More info regarding Community Links (link to Community Links) ## 26\. Unlocked-Way-Too-Early Traps Your main focus in the early game should be on leveling up and expanding your land. Some features available early on are best ignored, as they can quickly deplete your resources and slow your overall progress. These include: * [Fishing](/en/beginners/guide-draft#h-34-fishing) * [Animals](/en/beginners/guide-draft#h-35-animals-petting-tools) * [Digging](/en/beginners/guide-draft#h-36-digging) * [Crafting Box](/en/beginners/guide-draft#h-38-crafting) * [Factions](/en/beginners/guide-draft#h-41-intro-to-factions) * [Chapter Race: Tickets and Weekly Chores](/en/beginners/guide-draft#h-42-intro-to-chapter-race-chapter-tickets-and-tasks) * [Potion Room](/en/beginners/guide-draft#h-44-eins-potion-room) ## 27\. Island Upgrade / Prestige You can Prestige or upgrade to a new island once you’ve reached the maximum number of Land Expansions available and gathered the required upgrade resources. Upgrading will unlock more game mechanics and discover new resources. The Prestige progression: Basic/tutorial > Petal > Desert > Volcano \> Swamp (coming soon) More info regarding Prestige/Expansions (link Prestige/Expansions) # II. MID GAME You only got a taste of what to expect from the Early game. Keep building your farm and acquire more experience as you progress to the Petal and Desert Island. ## 28\. Petal Island You unlock additional resources (Fruits, Flowers+Beehive, Crimstone and Sunstone) and more game mechanics by upgrading to Petal Island. You also get the Blossombeard (+10% EXP) as a bonus. ## 29\. Four-Seasons & Unknown Events Every 7-days a new season will appear (Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter).  It will take 14-days after you the upgrade before your in-game calendar synchronizes with the Global Events. Unknown Events could bring a Positive Event (buff) or Negative Event (debuff) to your Farm. To protect your Island from Negative Weather Events, go to Bailey at the Plaza and buy the weather protection items that should be on your Land before any Unknown Events. ![](/user-pages/jaepi/guide-uwu/infog-unknown_event_101.png) More info regarding [Unknown Events.](/en/mechanics/seasons#calendar) ## 30\. Seasonal Crops, Fruits and Flowers & Beehive Pay attention to the current season. Each type of produce can only be planted during its designated season. For more information, check Betty’s Market Guide. Seeds that are out of season cannot be bought. You can now grow Fruits on the Fruit Patch. To plant a new Fruit, harvest the newly discovered Apple Tree several times until it withers. You then can chop it down to clear the Fruit Patch for replanting. You can also start planting Flowers and harvesting Honey. You can experiment with different flower combinations to produce specific Flowers. The Beehive fills only when a Flower is planted. A Bee Swarm gives your current crops a +0.2 yield. This can occur (10% chance) when a full Beehive(at 100%) is harvested.  More info regarding [Flowers.](/en/mechanics/flowers) ## 31\. Discover the Magical Gems Along with wood and minerals, you can now mine Magical gems (Crimstone and Sunstone). Mining Crimstones for five consecutive days gives a bonus yield on the fifth day. A Sunstone rock can only be mined up to ten times before it disappears forever but it has a special use case. ## 32\. Infernos & Sunstone Infernos is a location in the World Map (Lv30 Required) not to be confused with Volcano Island/Prestige. Here you can exchange your mined Sunstones for additional Resource nodes from Gunther. More info regarding [Infernos/Sunstone.](/en/mechanics/sunstone) ## 33\. Composters ![](/user-pages/jaepi/guide-uwu/faq_composter_overview_chart.webp) Composters are buildings (from the Workbench) that produce Fertilizers and Bait/Worm and it will require resources in order for it to run. Only one type of crop fertilizer (Sprout Mix or Rapid Root) can be used at a time.  ## 34\. Fishing & Crustaceans Fishing will require you to have Fishing Rods (from Workbench), a Bait (produced by a Composter) and Chum (optional). Fishing gives either a Fish or Treasure/Item. Fish can be used in Deliveries/Mega Bounty Board or be eaten for XP. Some Fish deliveries are also not worth the effort and cost to complete.  Make sure to build the Fish Market to turn your catches into special processed items. These products are used to cook special seafood dishes, and can also be used as bait to ensure the next fish you catch will be exactly the one you want. You can maximize your fishing gains by fishing during Fishing Frenzy Days. You can also slowly complete the Fishing Codex Achievements for the Wearables and Collectibles with Boost. The fishing pier on your island is the perfect place to place Crab Pots. Fill them with rare items as chum and passively attract special sea creatures. Use these Crustaceans for deliveries, bounties, or to cook powerful foods. More info regarding [Fishing.](/en/mechanics/fishing) ## 35\. Animals & Petting Tools You can build the Hen House and/or the Barn to start taking care of Animals. Animals are Skill and Boost dependent especially Cows and Sheep since they can eat up plenty of your crops. How-to-animals: * You buy an animal and they are hungry by default. * Make their food using the Feeder Machine (Corn, Wheat and Barley required). * Feed them preferably with their favorite food for more animal XP. * They will level up and go to sleep once their XP bar is full. * They will ask the use of petting tools while they sleep (this is optional and only gives bonus animal XP). * Once they are awake then you can collect their produce and they become hungry once again. * Beware of animal sickness as it can spread to the healthy animals. Use Barn Delight Medicine to cure them. * Complete weekly animal bounties by trading your animals for rewards (sick animals only earn 75% of the reward) More info regarding [Animals.](/en/mechanics/animals) ## 36\. Digging Digging is one reliable source of coins once mastered. You also need to sustain crafting Shovels and Gem Restock in order to maintain the Digging Streak. More info regarding [Digging.](/en/mechanics/digging) ## 37\. Crafting You can now build the Crafting Box to craft some Beds or items that can be used for Deliveries. More info regarding [Crafting.](/en/mechanics/crafting) ## 38\. Beds & Farmhands Beds employ farm hands. It will be +1 farm hand  for every unique bed on your farm. Your Main Bumpkin and Farm hands can be equipped with wearables. If you have more than 1 wearable with boosts, you can equip other farm hands with your additional wearables so that those boosts apply to your farm.  ## 39\. Market Place Access Upgrading to Petal Island and onward grants you the access to Sell on the Market-Place. Just be aware of the tax when selling. ![](/user-pages/jaepi/guide-uwu/faq_mp_tax.webp) Market Place Tax Breakdown. ## 40\. Intro to Factions You can pledge your allegiance to one of the four Factions: Bumpkins, Goblins, Nightshades, or Sunflorians. All Factions share the same mechanics:  * Eldric’s Faction Shop access * Faction Pet and XP Boost perks * Faction Kitchen * Weekly Faction War and it's rewards The main differences between them are their names, Faction Gear designs, and overall vibe.   Joining a Faction requires paying a [Membership Fee](/en/faq#how-to-join-factions). You may [leave your current Faction](/en/faq#can-i-leave-the-faction-how-to-leave-the-faction) to join another, but doing so will require paying the another Membership Fee and incur a 6-week penalty of no Faction Pet XP boost. Marks serve as the primary Faction currency that is earned and spent within Faction-related activities. You can use Marks at Eldric’s Faction Shop to purchase Wearables, Collectibles, Temporary Boosts, Food, and Keys.  Emblems provide a multiplier boost for Marks earned on Faction Pet Feeding and the Faction Kitchen. It can be bought at the Market Place. Players typically join a Faction early to gain the Faction Pet’s EXP Bonus. To become a contributing member, you’ll need to have all Cooking Buildings and Crafting Box.  ![](/user-pages/jaepi/guide-uwu/infog-faction_101.png) More info regarding [Factions.](/en/factions) ## 41\. Intro to Chapter Race: Chapter Tickets and Tasks Chapters are recurring three-month-long events in Sunflower Land. You can complete various tasks to earn Chapter Tickets and Chapter Points. Tasks that reward Chapter Tickets include: * Daily Login Reward- 1 Ticket * Ticket Deliveries- 5 Points per Ticket * Weekly Chores- 3 Point per Ticket * Animal Ticket Bounties- 5 Points per Ticket * Poppy’s Mega Bounty Board- 5 Points per Ticket Things you can use Tickets for: * Entries into the weekly Raffles- 10 entries per ticket, plus special Chapter Raffle Tickets worth 1 entry each * Bid in the auctions that take place near the end of the Chapter (Auction Week) * Buy items at Stella's Megastore Each Chapter features its own exclusive Stella's Store Items, Chapter Tickets, Digging Treasures, Marine Marvels and Mutants (Rare Flowers, Cows, Sheep, and Chickens). They are only obtainable during their own specific Chapter. Once a new Chapter begins, the remaining previous Chapter Tickets and Digging Treasures cannot be used anymore but they still can be sold for Coins.  You do not need to complete every task at this stage. Many tasks can be costly so prioritize the ones you can manage while continuing to build your farm. You can instead use this time to experience the flow of how things work to better prepare for upcoming Chapters. More info regarding [Chapters.](/en/mechanics/chapters) ## 42\. Mutants Mutants are Chapter-exclusive collectibles that randomly spawn when you do certain tasks. Mutants can either be a boost or a cosmetic.  List of mutants and how to get them: * Mutant Chicken - Harvesting Chicken * Mutant Cow - Harvesting Cow * Mutant Sheep - Harvesting Sheep * Mutant Flower - Harvesting Flower * Chapter Fish - Fishing during Full-Moon The chance of obtaining a mutant is VERY small. Don't be discouraged if you go several chapters regularly growing and ranching and never find one. They can always be bought from the Marketplace after the chapter is over. Mutant Crops are not Chapter-bound collectibles that are harvested from Magic Beans (Potion House). There are only three Mutant Crops (Potent Potato, Radical Radish and Stellar Sunflower), all of which can be bought at the Marketplace also. ## 43\. Eins & Potion Room Eins' Potion Room requires Coins to play and is where you earn Potion Tickets. You can exchange the Potion Tickets for Magic Beans, Lab-Grown Collectibles and Exotic Crops.  More info regarding [Potion Room.](/en/mechanics/minigames/Potion-House) ## 44\. Desert Prestige You unlock Oil and Oil-dependent Buildings (Green House and Crop Machine) by upgrading to Desert Island. You also get the Desert Gnome (+10% Cooking Speed) as a bonus. You can no longer use Gems to instantly complete the Expansion time. ## 45\. Oil, Greenhouse and Crop Machine You can now harvest Oil. It is not a tradeable resource. Each harvest yields 10 Oil, with a bonus of +20 Oil on every third drill (10, 10, 30 pattern). You can also build the Greenhouse and Crop Machine. These buildings require Oil to operate so it can be costly to operate without the proper Skills and Boosts. The Greenhouse allows you to grow 2 different types of crops (Rice, Olive) and 1 fruit (Grape). I will require Oil to grow them: * Grape - 3 Oil per seed * Rice - 4 Oil per seed * Olive - 6 Oil per seed Crop Machine automates your crop production for certain Basic and Medium Crops. You now have the option of not manually planting thousands of Sunflower. You can unlock additional crop options for the Crop Machine through Machinery Skills. More info regarding [Greenhouse](/en/mechanics/harvesting#greenhouse) and Crop Machine. ## 46\. Faction War participation Faction is a burn-to-earn Marks system. So before you participate, it’s recommended to have Emblems (at least a +300% Multiplier Rank) to maximize your rewards. The long-term goal is to acquire exclusive Faction Gear such as the Faction Shield, Faction Quiver or Medallion. Join the Faction War to complete faction tasks (Pet Feeding and Faction Kitchen), climb the leaderboard, and earn Marks. The Faction War ranks each Faction based on the total Marks accumulated by their Top 100 members. Weekly leaderboard rewards are given to the Top 100 members of each Faction.  The winning Faction will also receive a bonus +10% Marks based from their contribution. More info regarding [Factions.](/en/factions) # III. Late Game You’ve come a long way to reach this stage of the game. Welcome to the  late game. Enjoy the fruits of your journey and keep growing your legacy in Sunflower Land. ## 47\. Volcano Prestige You unlock the Lava pit and Obsidian by upgrading to Volcano Island. You also get the Volcano Gnome (+0.1 Mineral Yield) as a bonus. ## 48\. Lava pit & Obsidian You can now produce Obsidian by throwing resources at the Lava pit.  More info regarding Lava pit requirements ## 49\. Chapter Race participation You’ve advanced far enough to build a farm capable of handling the demands of collecting Chapter Tickets and Chapter Pass Points. Tickets can be used as entries to the weekly Raffles, or you can save them up to bid on top-tier auctions. More info regarding [Chapters.](/en/chapter-race/chapters) # LXIX. Returning Players Sunflower Land has evolved far beyond a simple farming simulator. With this evolution come new mechanics, gameplay updates, and the retirement of some older features. This section gives a quick recap for returning players before diving back into the full guide. Changes relating to Tokens and currency: * Token Changes: SFF > SFL token (in Polygon Network) > $FLOWER token (in Base Network and Ronin Network). * SFL that are in-game were automatically converted to $FLOWER. * Remaining Block Bucks in your inventory can be sold for Gems at Garbo (Retreat). * Buying Seeds and Tools: Pol (ex-Matic) > Block Bucks > Coins * Restocking Seeds and Tools: Pol (ex-Matic) > Block Bucks > Gems * Buying Farm Hands using Block Bucks (Farmhand coupon) > now Crafting Beds to add Farmhand. Integration of new game mechanics: * Bumpkins & Bumpkin Levels. If you can’t find your House/Tent or Bumpkin look for it in your Basket/Inventory. * Chapters * Four-Seasons, Seasonal Crops, Fruits and Flowers * Land Expansion & Prestige * Grub Shop is replaced by NPC Delivery * Crab Pot stations near the fishing pier * Salt Farm next to fishing pier Some game mechanic changes and discontinuation: * Only 1 Hen House is required. You can sell the extra Hen House and Legacy Chickens at Garbo. * Only 1 Water Well structure is required. You can sell the extra Water Well at Garbo. * The Tent was discontinued and can be sold at Garbo. * The Wishing Well is discontinued, but you can still get rewards from liquidity positions from a link in the Marketplace Dashboard. * Bert's Obsession and Poppy's Request were merged to form Poppy's Mega Board. * Goblin Exchange was discontinued to prioritize the use of the Market Place. [\[ Back to the top \]](/en/beginners/guide-draft#i-early-game) > **Contributors to this page** > > [_Jaepi_](/en/user-pages/Jaepi) _- primary content, infographics, images_ > > [_Haesoo_](/en/user-pages/Haesoo) _- legit check, info tables_ > > [_iSPANK_](/en/user-pages/iSPANK) _- minor edits and links_ > > [_librophagus_](/en/user-pages/librophagus)_\- updates and edits_

title: Stock & Limits
markdown:
# Stock & Limits

An important concept for every player to learn is the limitations placed on the number of seeds and tools available in the shops on your home island. Once you buy all of the stock for a particular item, you will not be able to buy any more until you pay for a Restock, which requires certain resources.

You can view the stock amounts for your shops at [https://sfl.world/stock/](https://sfl.world/stock/) (Enter your Farm ID). These amounts are influenced by the buildings and other boosts you have built so far.

## Seeds

Every crop, fruit, flower, and greenhouse plant has a limited stock of seeds. Once these are used up, you will need to pay for the Market Restock, which costs 15 Gems and will replenish every seed in the above category by the maximum amount. This means that if the stock limit is exceeded, the extra seeds will be lost. For example, if your stock limit of Sunflowers is 1000 seeds, and you buy 500, then Restock, you have 1000 seeds added to your market. The other 500 are essentially lost. 

You can increase the amount of every seed you receive per Restock by 20% through building the Warehouse on your farm.

The Crime Fruit skill increases the restock amount of Tomato and Lemon seeds by +10/+25/+50. The Fruity Heaven skill decreases the Coin cost of all fruit seeds by 10%/15%/20%

The Flower Sale skill decreases the price of flower seeds by 20%/25%/30%.

The Seedy Business skill decreases the cost of greenhouse seeds by 15%/20%/25%.

The three amounts for each skill are for each of the three ranks that you can upgrade through [Ascension Shards](/en/mechanics/ascension).

## Farm Tools

Axes, Pickaxes, Stone Pickaxes, Iron Pickaxes, Gold Pickaxes, Oil Drills, Fishing Rods, Crab Pots, Mariner Pots, and Salt Rakes are all replenished by the Workbench Restock.

You can increase the amount of every workbench tool by 50% by building and placing the Toolshed on your farm.

The More Axes skill increases the amount of that tool by +50/+100/+150.  
The Frugal Miner decreases the coin cost of all pickaxes (Normal, Stone, Iron, Gold) by 20%/30%/40%.

The Reel Deal skill decreases the coin cost of Fishing Rods by 50%/55%/60%.

The Cheap Rakes skill decreases the coin cost of Salt Rakes by 20%/30%/40%.

The More Picks skill increases the stock amount of every type of pickaxe by a large amount.

| Tool | I | II | II |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pickaxe | 70 | 140 | 280 |
| Stone Pickaxe | 20 | 40 | 80 |
| Iron Pickaxe | 7 | 14 | 28 |
| Gold Pickaxe | 2 | 4 | 8 |

## Digging Tools

Sand Shovels and Sand Drills are covered under the Digging Restock. There are no items or skills which increase the stock of digging tools at this time.

## Restocks

For every Restock type except Free, you must have run out of at least one of the items in the shop before the Restock button will become available.

### Free Restock

Every day, a small ship will appear below your island, which will add a few tools, basic and medium crop seeds to your stock. The amounts added cannot exceed your total shop limit, so you may see fewer items listed in your game window. The seeds will be added to your stock even if they cannot be grown in the current season, so you will be able to buy them when that season arrives again.

This restock does not cost any Gems. [Source](https://github.com/sunflower-land/sunflower-land/blob/main/src/features/game/events/landExpansion/shipmentRestocked.ts)

*   Tools Provided:
    *   50x Axes
    *   15x Pickaxes
    *   5x Stone Pickaxes
    *   1x Iron Pickaxes
    *   10x Fishing Rods
    *   5x Sand Shovels
*   Seeds Provided:
    *   100x Sunflower
    *   50x Potato
    *   50x Rhubarb
    *   30x Pumpkin
    *   30x Zucchini
    *   20x Carrot
    *   20x Yam
    *   20x Cabbage
    *   20x Broccoli
    *   20x Soybean
    *   20x Beetroot
    *   20x Pepper
    *   20x Cauliflower
    *   10x Parsnip

### Market Restock

Only available at the Farmer's Market. This option costs 15 Gems, and replenishes the stock for all of your crops, fruits, flowers, and greenhouse goods. 

### Workbench Restock

Only available at the Workbench. This option costs 10 Gems, and replenishes the stock of all the tools available there.

### Digging Restock

Only available from Jafar at the Beach. This option costs 5 gems to give you 50 Sand Shovels and 10 Sand Drills.

### Full Restock

For 20 Gems, you can restock every item across all three stores: seeds, workbench and digging. This is available at any of the three shops. While this is clearly the most economical option, it should only be considered when you are running low on multiple categories of items.

## Inventory Limits

While it may seem like the best choice to just buy up everything in the store before paying for a Full Restock, you must keep in mind that there are not only shop limits, but inventory limits also. Your limit for seeds is 2.5 times your stock amount, for tools it varies for each one.

So why don't you just wait until you've used up every re-stockable item before buying another one? As you progress in the game and start buying cheaper resources like Sunflowers and Potatoes, you will find yourself not growing those crops at all, and therefore always having more than you need on hand. Or, you will follow the usual progression of Axes, Pickaxes, but then buy rods and shovels instead of Stone Pickaxes to get Iron. Then you run out of Pickaxes and can't mine Stone at all. 

Then it's time for a Restock. You could clear out the shop and build up inventory before buying it, but that can use up Coins very quickly. It's difficult to give a clear strategy when it comes to this situation, since everyone's play styles are so different, but it is clear that trying to only Restock when the shops are completely empty is not really feasible. You will start “overflowing” items, and it is up to you if you want to wait and use up as much as you can before a Restock, or just go ahead and keep playing the way you want.

## History

Restocks were previously paid for using a resource called Block Bucks. These could only be bought with MATIC/POL, or a debit/credit card, not SFL (the precursor to FLOWER). This made the game completely not free-to-play, as you could not buy a restock without paying money of some kind, and without a restock, you could not progress. Now, it is technically possible to earn enough FLOWER through the Marketplace and buy Gems for Restocks, but only if you have invested enough in your farm and character to be able to turn a profit in the first place.

With Block Bucks, there was only one option to Restock, equivalent to the Full Restock available today. This was one of the reasons that Gems were introduced, as a Restock cost 1 Block Buck, and they could not be subdivided. With Gems, multiple Restock options could be made available for smaller amounts of value.

markdown:
# Travel Map

![](/beginners_guide/map.png)

The whole world at your fingertips

# Travel Map

In the lower-left corner of your screen is the Map, which will let you travel to any of the zones that you have currently unlocked. Click or tap on a zone to travel there instantly, with **no cost or fee of any kind**. In any area other than your home farm, use the arrow keys, WASD, or the pointer at the bottom of your screen to move around and explore the world!

## Home

Your home farm, where most of your time will be spent. You can scroll to view the edges of your land, but cannot walk around like you can in other zones.

## Plaza

The Pumpkin Plaza, this is where you will find many NPCs for deliveries, the Mega Bounty Board, Stella's Megastore, the Potion Room, and two of the keyed treasure chests. The upcoming Pet shop will also be located here.

## Beach (Lvl 4)

Here you will find many other NPCs to make deliveries to, including the master fisher Finn, from whom you can buy rare Fishing Lures. It is also the home of the mysterious Dig Site, where you can unearth many valuable treasures.

## Digging (Lv 4)

This hotspot also takes you to the Beach zone, but at the uppermost entrance right next to Jafar's shop and the Dig Site.

## Retreat (Lvl 5)

The hungry goblins have made their home here, and will accept food in return for valuable FLOWER tokens. This is also the home of Goblet and Garbo, who will turn your trash into treasure, and a powerful goblin who can transport your items and resources across a magic block-chain to be transferred to other farmers.

## Kingdom/Faction (Lvl 7)

Participate in the clash of Factions! Join one of four elite groups and work together to earn Marks and powerful rewards. Once you join a Faction, you will also be able to jump directly to their Faction House whenever you want. There are also royal NPCs here who only accept the finest goods for their deliveries.

## Infernos (Lvl 30)

A volcanic land where a tribe of red-skinned goblins live, the inhabitants of this fiery island trade in sunstone and obsidian, promising enormous benefits in exchange for both.

## Shortcuts

Each link on the map will take you to the entrance to the zone that is closest to the one you are currently in. If you are at your home island, the Retreat, or another zone that doesn't directly link to your destination, you'll end up at the closest entrance relative to the Plaza. This feature can be used to your advantage to jump directly to certain areas.

### Faction Shop

Want to save some steps before cashing in those hard-earned Marks? Teleport to the Digging Site, then walk to the right into the Kingdom and you are there.

### Raven/Tywin

To make a delivery to either of these troublemakers, teleport to the Kingdom, then walk downward toward the Plaza. You will be in the upper-left corner of the map.

### Minigame Portal

If you are lucky enough to be in the Bumpkins Faction, teleport to the Faction House, then walk out the front door to be right in front of the portal. Nightshades also have a shorter walk from their House.

### Gambit

This solitary goblin can be reached easily by teleporting to the Kingdom and walking up to him.

### Bert/Timmy/Betty

If the trouble in the Woodlands ever subsides, the path to these three NPCs will open back up: teleport to the Woodlands, then walk left into the Plaza. Until then, this shortcut is purely historical.

title: Liquidity Pool Rewards
markdown:
# Liquidity Pool Rewards

An excellent way to support the cryptocurrency ecosystem of the game and receive multiple kinds of rewards is to participate in the liquidity pool for FLOWER & USDC. This can be a little complicated for people who are unfamiliar with crypto, so let's toss a coin in the Wishing Well and get started!

## Pool Basics

Think of a liquidity pool as a money changer. If you travel to another country and have cash from your home country, you need to change it to the native currency. The money changer has a certain amount of both currencies on hand, and can trade your foreign money for the domestic money. Then, another traveler is returning home and needs to make an exchange in the opposite direction. Some of your money will end up being given to that traveler instead.

A liquidity pool enables cryptocurrency swaps between two different tokens, and the one we will focus on is USDC/FLOWER. This lets players with cash buy FLOWER and use it in the game, and it lets others who want out of the game to sell their items and get cash. All of that currency has to come from somewhere, so the developers are encouraging people to contribute their money to the pool, and offering rewards in return.

## Holding a Position

To begin, you will need a cryptocurrency wallet like Metamask. You can use whichever one you prefer, but it must support both the Base blockchain and the Polygon network. If you haven't minted your farm, make sure to do that now, and have your farm's NFT in the wallet you want to use. That is how the rewards will come to you.

You will also need some amount of ETH on the Base network to pay for gas fees.

Go to [https://app.uniswap.org/buy](https://app.uniswap.org/buy) and get your USDC from your preferred funding source. Make sure it is on the Base network. Use [this link](https://app.uniswap.org/swap?chain=base&inputCurrency=0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913&outputCurrency=0x3e12b9d6a4d12cd9b4a6d613872d0eb32f68b380&value=1&field=input) to directly swap USDC for FLOWER, and only swap 50%. The value in USD of both tokens will not be exactly the same, but it is close enough.

![](/beginners_guide/flower-usd.png)

Once you have an equal amount of FLOWER and USDC, use this [very fancy link](https://app.uniswap.org/positions/create/v3?currencyA=0x3e12b9d6a4d12cd9b4a6d613872d0eb32f68b380&currencyB=0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913&chain=base&hook=undefined&priceRangeState=%7B%22priceInverted%22:false,%22fullRange%22:false,%22minPrice%22:%22%22,%22maxPrice%22:%22%22,%22initialPrice%22:%22%22,%22inputMode%22:%22price%22%7D&depositState=%7B%22exactField%22:%22TOKEN0%22,%22exactAmounts%22:%7B%7D%7D) to jump straight to the create position screen. A position is your stake in the pool. The options should be auto-filled for you, but if they are not, ensure that the first token is FLOWER, the second is USDC, and that the position is **v3**, not any other v. Don't worry about the fee tier, 0.3% is the default and is fine.

![](/beginners_guide/create-position.png)

On the next screen, ignore the rest of the options and go down to the Deposit Tokens section. Use all of the FLOWER you swapped. You will probably have a few USDC cents left over, but that is fine. It's not really possible to get it perfect. Review, sign, and process the remaining transactions to create your position. You are now helping the game in a whole new way!

## Managing Liquidity

When all is said and done, you will get a cool NFT in your wallet that signifies your ownership of your position. Each position has a unique URL with Uniswap where you can manage your money. You can Add Liquidity at any time, provided you have a 50/50 split of FLOWER and USDC like you did when you created the position initially.

You can also Remove Liquidity, which gives you your tokens back. You can't specify a precise amount, though, you must enter in a percentage of your total holding to extract it. All of these actions require a blockchain transaction and to pay ETH as a gas fee.

## Collecting Rewards

### In-Game

![](/beginners_guide/flowerdashboard.png)

After your position is created, go to the Flower Dashboard in the Marketplace and click on the Rewards link in the Liquidity box. This will signal to the game that you own a position and you will start receiving daily rewards. Even then, it may take a few days for your rewards to start arriving. You will get an initial gift of a Coin Head wearable hat, which is a little gaudy but still fun. Every day when you log in for the first time, you will get a random Reward Box from any of the four categories, including Flower. The tier is scaled to the amount of your position, though there is no data available as to how much you need to deposit to earn a specific tier of box. But, it is a reliable source of items, provided you maintain your position!

### Uniswap

Uniswap itself provides a pool reward, which is a percentage of the fees collected when trading tokens across the pair. You can Collect any fees you've earned from your position's page. It is paid to you in both FLOWER and USDC, which you can then deposit into the game or back into the pool for more rewards.

## History

### Merkl

Merkl rewards were a secondary method of rewarding players for holding liquidity, which was removed in late 2025. The old [campaign dashboard](https://app.merkl.xyz/opportunities/base/CLAMM/0xafE30319a948F322585faFC1Cab1671A47eB3786) is visible at that link.

Merkl provided a leaderboard of position holders, but if you're trying to rise to the top spot and want to know how much to invest, the leaderboard isn't helpful. It shows the cumulative rewards earned by a particular address, not the amount of its position. If you want to know that, you have to take the address to a tool like Basescan, find the NFT for the position in that wallet, take the position ID back to Uniswap, and find the amount of the position. That's tedious work! If you are committed to being #1, just remember that as of the time of this writing, the top position in the pool is worth 73,000 USDC!

title: Home Island
markdown:
# Home Island

Your home island is where the majority of the game and basic game mechanics happen.

## Mechanics

On your home island there are a number of “main mechanics" that are the “Core” of Sunflower Land's game play loop. (a full list of game mechanic pages can be seen [here](/t/game-mechanics))

*   [Crops](/en/mechanics/harvesting#crops)
*   [Fruits](/en/mechanics/harvesting#fruit)
*   [Mining](/en/mechanics/mining)
*   [Fishing](/en/mechanics/fishing)
*   [Crafting](/e/en/mechanics/crafting)
*   [Skills](/en/mechanics/skills)
*   [Animals](/en/home#animals)

It's important to have a firm grasp of these core mechanics in order to progress yourself in Sunflower Land.

## Buildings

You start out with access to some buildings like; the **House**,  **Firepit**, and **Blacksmith**. But other buildings you will need to build, and others you will need to “prestige your island” to gain access to.

### Basic

*   **water well** (more plot fertility, some plots may not be use-able until you upgrade your water well)
*   **kitchen** (cooking more food types)
*   **crafting box** (access to craft-able items)
*   **compost bin**, **turbo composter**, **premium composter** (access to: fertilizer, fruitful blend, and rapid root)
*   **Bakery** (access to baking cakes)
*   **Deli** (access to more food types, namely Cheese)

### Petal Paradise

*   **hen house** (access to chickens)
*   **barn** (access to cows and sheep)
*   **flowers**
*   **beehives**

### Desert

*   **Crop Machine** (at the cost of oil, grow basic crops automatically; expands to more crops with skills)
*   **Greenhouse** (at the cost of oil, grow Grapes, Rice, and Olives)
*   **Oil**

### Volcano

*   **Lavapits/Obsidian**

## Leveling Up

Leveling up is extremely important, maybe even the MOST important part of Sunflower Land.

Use your cooking buildings to make food from the plants your grow, and the animals you keep. Eat that food by clicking on your bumpkin (in front of your house) and then selecting the food you wish to eat. With each food you eat you gain XP. With enough XP you will level up.

Leveling up will gain you access to more Features and unlock further Expansions for your island.

## Expansions

Expansions are an the only way to make your Island bigger, but they also come with some nice additions to your island. 

When you expand your island you'll gain things like:

*   [Trees/Resource nodes](/en/mechanics/mining)
*   [Crop/Fruit Plots](/en/mechanics/harvesting#farming)
*   [Flower plots](/en/mechanics/flowers#flower-gardening)
*   [Beehives](/en/mechanics/flowers#beehives)
*   [Sunstones](/en/mechanics/sunstone)
*   AND MORE ON BIGGER ISLANDS! (for a full list go [here](https://sfl.world./info/expansion))

* * *

Each island is bigger then the last, and will therefore require more expansions (and more resources) to get to full size.  
Once your island is at its full size, you're ready to Upgrade your island!

## Upgrading Islands (Island Prestige)

There are several Islands that you will prestige through in your Sunflower Land Career. And each comes with special things that you couldn't access on the islands before it.

*   Basic (where you start)
*   Petal Paradise (Flowers, Honey, Animals)
*   Desert (Oil, Greenhouse, Crop Machine)
*   Volcano (Lava pits/Obsidian)
*   Swamp (coming soon)

Upgrading to the Best Island, in most cases, is the only way to ensure you can be “competitive” in the [chapter race](/en/chapter-race/basic-info).

## Conclusion

Initially in Sunflower Land you should: 

1.  Eat food to level up
2.  Expand your Island for more nodes
3.  Prestige to Bigger/Better islands for more features

# Seasons & Weather ## Seasons The cycle of the seasons is important to every farming game, and Sunflower Land is no exception! Every week, beginning on Monday, the season will change and new opportunities and challenges will arise. Learn to master the rhythms of the land with these guides. In every season, certain crops and fruits can be planted. You can only buy seeds for the current season, though many are available in multiple seasons. It's important to note that crops and fruits **will not die** when the season change happens on Monday. They will continue to grow as normal until you harvest them, you just won't be able to plant new ones unless they are compatible with the new season. Wheat is currently the only crop that can be grown in any season, due to its importance in cooking. Only one variety of flower is seasonal, the other three can be planted at any time. The greenhouse is unaffected by the seasons. Moon berries are also unaffected and can be planted any time you obtain a seed for one. Certain fish can only be caught in certain seasons, though the anchovy, tuna, red snapper, and all marine marvels can be caught year-round. Each season brings changes to the landscape also: your farm, the Plaza, and the Kingdom all have different graphics depending on the week. The Beach and Retreat are unchanged.
